messages:
Anna (Platform): heads-up — a user hit a 400 from the embeddings endpoint and the SDK just returns "invalid payload". no dims or payload hints.
Sam (Eng-Platform): can you paste the request they sent?
Anna (Platform): small array of vectors, some entries were length 128, others 0. request body looked like: `{\n  "input": [[0.1,0.2...], [], [0.3,...]]\n}` — server returned 400 w/ `invalid payload`.
Tyler (SDK): that fits what SDK sees. We currently map any 4xx to a generic InvalidRequestError. We don't expose server error codes.
Sam (Eng-Platform): that's the problem. For routing/quota and console guidance we need a richer shape: error_code + field + hint + suggested fix. e.g. `EMB_DIM_MISMATCH` + `input[1]` + `expected 1536` or `empty vector`.
June (Console): console needs that to show inline hints. Right now users see "invalid payload" and open a support ticket. If we get structured errors we can show a tooltip: "Entry 2 is empty — drop or pad to X dims" and a quick link to SDK docs.
Tyler (SDK): proposal for error JSON payload (server -> client):
```
{
  "error": "EMB_DIM_MISMATCH",
  "message": "row 1: length 0, expected 1536",
  "hint": "remove empty vectors or send fixed-length arrays",
  "invalid_indices": [1],
  "expected_dim": 1536
}
```
If SDK surfaces that on InvalidRequestError we can also add `error_code` and `meta` fields.
Sam (Eng-Platform): +1. Also want telemetry keys for dashboarding: `embed.request.shape_error`, tag by `error_code`, `tenant_id`, and `route`. add `embed.request.input_count` and `embed.request.avg_dim` on failure events so we can pivot.
Anna (Platform): routing behavior question — if one item is wrong in a batch do we fail entire request or attempt per-item validation and return partial success? the runtime currently fails entire batch early.
Tyler (SDK): from SDK UX, partial success is messy: partial ordering, retries, cost accounting. But failing whole batch is surprising for users who expect only bad items rejected.
Sam (Eng-Platform): We should be explicit in the API contract. Option A: fail whole request (current) with `EMB_BATCH_INVALID` and indices. Option B: allow `partial=true` query param to accept partial responses and return `items` array with per-item status and unit charge table. Option C: client-side preflight endpoint that returns a cheap validation (no model run) — similar to preflight console checks. Thoughts?
June (Console): Console could surface a toggle in the embed route: "Reject batches with invalid rows" vs "Return partial responses (beta)". For rollout, default to current behavior to avoid billing complexity, then opt-in for `partial=true` in a canary.
Anna (Platform): agree. rollout plan: (1) add structured errors and telemetry (non-breaking) (2) console hint + docs (3) add `partial=true` behind a feature flag and a quota/units dashboard card that shows how charges are computed for partial responses.
Tyler (SDK): implementation note — need stable error codes and backwards compat: if `error_code` missing, SDK falls back to legacy behavior. Also publish schema in `/openapi/errors.yaml` and bump SDK release notes.
Sam (Eng-Platform): telemetry fields to add to ingestion schema: `embed.error.code`, `embed.error.invalid_indices`, `embed.request.expected_dim`, `embed.ingress.avg_dim`, `embed.ingress.count`. We'll want sampled traces for large failures.
June (Console): also add an autofix suggestion link for common cases: "Pad to 1536 using zeros" and show a client snippet. Not all users should do this automatically but it helps debug.
Anna (Platform): security/compliance check — be careful with showing raw payload snippets in console. Use sanitized examples (show length but not values).
Tyler (SDK): ok. I'll draft the error schema PR and a quick SDK PR that surfaces `error_code`/`meta` and prints `hint` in error.message.
Sam (Eng-Platform): I'll open an infra ticket to emit the telemetry keys and a short dashboard mock. Tagging @June for console UI.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: eng-platform/errors-schema-v1 -> canary.
June (Console): when the canary is live pls ping `#eng-platform` and I'll flip a console flag to show hints for the canary tenants only. :party_parrot:
Anna (Platform): nice. target: structured errors + telemetry in canary by EOW. If we see high rate of `EMB_DIM_MISMATCH` we can add client-side preflight next sprint.
Sam (Eng-Platform): thanks everyone. saving notes to the runbook and dashboard card template.
Tyler (SDK): PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/421 (draft).
